title: Репетиция предложения руки и сердца  (Rehearsing the Marriage Proposal)

segments.t: Convinced by Kostya's advice, Denis rehearses a romantic marriage proposal for Katya in the kitchen, and Senya and Fedya volunteer to drop rose petals from the balcony during the ceremony. Listen to the rehearsal.
Катя, мы с тобой уже вместе.
Ты моя жизнь и моя вселенная.
А мы тебе в этом поможем.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Катя, мы с тобой уже вместе.
'Katya, you and I are together now.' Claiming that Fedya and he are together now sounds confident, even if Fedya has doubts.

'You fill my life with meaning.' Pointing out that Fedya fills his life with meaning gives Fedya a sobering reality check. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.

'Without you I am not myself.' Denis explains that without Fedya he is not himself, keeping his voice calm and direct. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'Without you I am nobody.' Realizing that without Fedya he is nobody changes how Denis handles the situation.
'And I do not want to be anyone else.' With the moment and promise in play, Denis keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'You are my world.' Even though Fedya is his world, Denis keeps a steady face in front of Fedya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Ты моя жизнь и моя вселенная.
'You are my life and my universe.' Admitting that Fedya is his life and his universe shows Denis being honest for a change.
'My dear Katya.' Over the moment and the promise, Denis answers Fedya without a second thought.

'Will you marry me?' Asking whether Fedya marries him cuts straight through the tension between Denis and Fedya. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'What do you think, will she forgive me?' Wondering what Fedya thinks will she forgive him is how Denis puts Fedya on the spot.
'Very cool, she will definitely forgive you.' Senya tells Denis that very cool she will definitely forgive Denis without dressing it up.
А мы тебе в этом поможем.
'And we will help you with that.' Since they will help Denis, Fedya does not waste words on excuses. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.

'Pay attention to the balcony above.' Claiming that Denis should pay attention to the balcony above sounds confident, even if Denis has doubts. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Катя, мы с тобой уже вместе.
Ты моя жизнь и моя вселенная.
А мы тебе в этом поможем.
And that finishes Denis's proposal rehearsal. Notice the idiom for a woman getting married—literally 'will you go out behind me'. See you next time!

lines.fragment: Катя, с тех пор, как мы вместе
Ты моя жизнь. Ты моя вселенная
Как думаете, если так сделаю, простит она меня?
А мы тебе в этом поможем
